map.根据收缩压和舒张压判断血压分类（中国高血压防治指南标准）: Classify a systolic/diastolic reading into normal, elevated or hypertension stages, and show pulse pressure and mean arterial pressure alongside tailored advice.

map.分级：正常 <120/80，升高 120–129，1级 130–139/80–8: Grading: normal <120/80, elevated 120-129, stage 1 130-139/80-89, stage 2 ≥140/90 (per ACC/AHA 2017)

map.正确测量血压的方法: How to measure blood pressure correctly
map.• 测量前30分钟内不吸烟、不喝咖啡、不运动: • No smoking, coffee or exercise within 30 minutes before measuring
map.• 排空膀胱，安静休息至少5分钟: • Empty your bladder and rest quietly for at least 5 minutes
map.• 选择合适的袖带（袖带气囊应包裹80%上臂周径）: • Choose the right cuff (the cuff bladder should wrap 80% of the upper-arm circumference)
map.• 取坐位，背靠椅背，双脚平放地面: • Sit with back against the chair back, feet flat on the floor
map.• 上臂裸露，置于桌面，与心脏同一水平: • Bare the upper arm, place it on the table at heart level
map.• 袖带下缘距肘窝2-3cm，松紧以能插入1指为宜: • Lower edge of cuff 2-3 cm above the elbow crease, snug enough to insert one finger
map.• 每日早晚各测1次，每次测2-3遍，间隔1分钟: • Measure once in the morning and once in the evening daily, 2-3 readings each time, 1 minute apart
map.• 早上：起床后1小时内，服药前、早餐前、排尿后: • Morning: within 1 hour of waking, before medication, before breakfast, after urination
map.• 初诊或治疗早期：连续测量7天，取后6天平均值: • At first diagnosis or early treatment: measure 7 consecutive days, take the average of the last 6 days
map.• 限盐：每日＜5g（约一啤酒瓶盖），减少隐性盐摄入: • Limit salt: <5 g per day (about one beer-bottle cap), reduce hidden salt intake
map.• 增钾：多吃新鲜蔬果、豆类、菌菇类: • Increase potassium: eat more fresh vegetables, fruit, legumes, mushrooms
map.• 减少饱和脂肪和胆固醇，增加优质蛋白: • Reduce saturated fat and cholesterol, increase high-quality protein
map.• 每周≥150分钟中等强度有氧运动（快走、慢跑、游泳）: • ≥150 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic exercise per week (brisk walking, jogging, swimming)
map.• 运动时收缩压避免超过220mmHg: • Avoid systolic exceeding 220 mmHg during exercise
map.• 控制体重：BMI＜24，腰围男＜90cm、女＜85cm: • Control weight: BMI <24, waistline men <90 cm, women <85 cm
map.• 戒烟限酒：男性酒精＜25g/天，女性＜15g/天: • Quit smoking and limit alcohol: men <25 g alcohol/day, women <15 g/day
map.• 减轻精神压力，保持心理平衡: • Reduce stress and keep psychological balance
map.• 保证充足睡眠，每晚7-8小时: • Get enough sleep, 7-8 hours per night
map.危险因素：高血压、年龄（男≥45岁，女≥55岁）、吸烟、血脂异常、早发心血管病家: Risk factors: hypertension, age (men ≥45, women ≥55), smoking, dyslipidemia, family history of early cardiovascular disease, obesity, physical inactivity
map.靶器官损害：左心室肥厚、颈动脉内膜增厚或斑块、肾功能受损等: Target-organ damage: left ventricular hypertrophy, carotid intima thickening or plaque, impaired kidney function, etc.
map.⚠️ 本工具仅供参考，不能替代医疗诊断。血压异常请及时就医，高血压患者请遵医嘱监: ⚠️ This tool is for reference only and cannot replace medical diagnosis. For abnormal blood pressure, seek medical advice promptly; hypertension patients should monitor and medicate as advised.

map.家庭自测血压后，按最新指南判断属于正常/升高/1级/2级高血压，决定是否需要就医: After home self-measurement, classify as normal/elevated/stage 1/stage 2 hypertension per the latest guideline, to decide whether to see a doctor or adjust lifestyle.
map.关注脉压（收缩压−舒张压）偏大或偏小时，结合平均动脉压(MAP)评估血管弹性与灌: When pulse pressure (systolic − diastolic) is large or small, combine with mean arterial pressure (MAP) to assess vascular elasticity and perfusion risk.
map.长期随访记录中对比收缩压/舒张压比值变化，辅助识别单纯收缩期高血压等老年性改变。: In long-term follow-up records, compare changes in systolic/diastolic ratio to help identify age-related changes such as isolated systolic hypertension.
map.Input: 收缩压 120 mmHg、舒张压 80 mmHg、年龄 40。\n:
Input: systolic 120 mmHg, diastolic 80 mmHg, age 40.
Calculation: pulse pressure = 120 − 80 = 40 mmHg; mean arterial pressure MAP ≈ diastolic + 1/3 x pulse pressure = 80 + 13.3 = 93.3 (about 93) mmHg; systolic/diastolic ratio = 120/80 = 1.50.
Conclusion: 120/80 is normal blood pressure, pulse pressure 40 is in the normal range (normal 30-50), cardiovascular

map.脉压过大或过小分别代表什么？: What do excessively large or small pulse pressure mean?
map.脉压 >60 mmHg（如 150/80）常见于动脉硬化、老年性单纯收缩期高血压: Pulse pressure >60 mmHg (e.g. 150/80) is common in arteriosclerosis and age-related isolated systolic hypertension; pulse pressure <30 mmHg may be seen in aortic stenosis and low cardiac output. This tool gives the pulse pressure value, but abnormalities must be judged clinically by a doctor and cannot replace diagnosis.
map.为什么平均动脉压不是简单的（高+低）÷2？: Why is mean arterial pressure not simply (high + low) ÷ 2?
map.心脏舒张期远长于收缩期，MAP 更接近「舒张压 + 1/3 脉压」而非算术平均。: The cardiac diastole lasts much longer than systole, so MAP is closer to 'diastolic + 1/3 pulse pressure' rather than the arithmetic mean. This tool uses this approximation to assess organ perfusion pressure; for critical or intraoperative cases, rely on precise values from invasive monitoring.
